functions.name: deployments
functions.description: Deployment requests at stable repository/deployment identity, independent of status-event multiplicity. Environment names are labels in deployment records and may refer to renamed or deleted environments; no environment-ID relationship is invented. Actor is deployment_creator, distinct from status creators. Arbitrary deployment payload values are not currently typed.

metrics.name: deployment_count
metrics.comment: Selected deployment request records, not successful deployments and not status updates.

derived_fields.name: deployment_created_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC calendar date from the returned created_at instant.

production_deployment_count.comment: Deployment records explicitly marked production; missing classification is not false.

functions.name: deployment_statuses
functions.description: All visible deployment status event records, including historical failures followed by success and states queued, pending, in_progress and inactive. This entity is not one latest state per deployment. Direct repository context is analytical; deployment parent navigation is retained without a competing analytical path or conflating deployment/status creator roles.

metrics.name: deployment_status_count
metrics.comment: Selected deployment status event records; multiple records can belong to one deployment.

metrics.name: successful_deployment_status_count
metrics.comment: Status events reporting success, not distinct successful deployments.

metrics.name: failed_deployment_status_count
metrics.comment: Status events reporting failure or error, including events superseded later.

metrics.name: pending_deployment_status_count
metrics.comment: Status events in a nonterminal pending, queued or in-progress state.

derived_fields.name: deployment_status_created_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC calendar date from the returned created_at instant.

functions.name: environments
functions.description: Current visible deployment environments at numeric identity, independent of deployment or policy populations. Branch-policy flags remain nullable when settings are absent or unrestricted; NULL must not be interpreted as a protected environment. Built-in wait-timer/reviewer rules remain typed nested metadata with all matching pinned anyOf variants; custom integration rules are a separate entity.

metrics.name: environment_count
metrics.comment: Current visible environment resources, including unused environments.

derived_fields.name: environment_created_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC calendar date from the returned created_at instant.

protected_branch_environment_count.comment: Environments explicitly restricted to protected branches.

custom_branch_environment_count.comment: Environments explicitly using named branch or tag policies.

functions.description: One current GitHub Pages deployment-status observation per repository and supplied lookup token. GitHub accepts deployment ID or commit SHA but returns no canonical ID, so aliases are not deduplicated into deployment business entities. Missing status remains unknown, not success.

metrics.comment: Status lookup observations, not a complete Pages deployment population or distinct deployments across aliases.

metrics.name: successful_pages_deployment_status_count
